description: Public engineering-authored synthetic corpus: 80 finance/support questions. Not an independent steward holdout, customer feed or model uplift test. Native versions and observation clocks are intentionally unknown, not fabricated.

cases.prompt: Define finance Revenue.

gold.value: Posted invoice amounts by native currency and invoice calendar month. Exclude void and draft invoices; refunds are negative; missing amounts remain unknown.

cases.prompt: Define support Revenue.

gold.value: Known billable resolution minutes on closed tickets; workload, not money.

cases.prompt: Define finance Active Customer.

gold.value: Account with a nonzero posted USD invoice in the selected month.

cases.prompt: Define support Active Customer.

gold.value: Organization with a nondeleted ticket opened in the selected month, including unresolved tickets.

cases.prompt: State invoice grain.

gold.value: one_invoice

cases.prompt: State ticket grain.

gold.value: one_ticket

cases.prompt: What is the native currency-code unit?

gold.value: ISO_currency_code

cases.prompt: What unit does Resolution use?

gold.value: minutes

cases.prompt: What aggregation does posted Revenue use?

gold.value: sum

cases.prompt: How is mean Resolution aggregated?

gold.value: mean_of_known_values

cases.prompt: Return Revenue's native upstream version, preserving unknown.
Return the native observation clock, preserving unknown.
State finance account namespace.

gold.value: finance.account_id

cases.prompt: State support organization namespace.

gold.value: support.organization_id

cases.prompt: Explain finance Owner identity.

gold.value: Owner is a finance user ID. Display-name equality proves no shared identity.

cases.prompt: Explain support Owner identity.

gold.value: Owner is a support user ID. Repeated display names do not identify a person.

cases.prompt: Explain invoice-to-payment grain risk.

gold.value: An invoice ID is unique within finance. One invoice may have several payments, so joining payments can multiply invoice amounts.

cases.prompt: Define measured SLA denominator.

gold.value: Closed tickets with measured resolution at or below their SLA are met. Missing durations are excluded from the measured denominator.

cases.prompt: Which time policy defines invoice months?

gold.value: invoice_date_calendar_month
